organization.fullName: Alliance for Clinical Trials in Oncology

identificationModule.briefTitle: Armodafinil in Reducing Cancer-Related Fatigue in Patients With High Grade Glioma
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase III Randomized, Double-Blind Placebo Controlled Study of Armodafinil (Nuvigil®) To Reduce Cancer-Related Fatigue in Patients With High Grade Glioma

armGroups.label: Arm I
armGroups.description: Patients receive 150 mg armodafinil orally every day in the morning for 8 weeks.

armGroups.label: Arm II
armGroups.description: Patients receive placebo orally every day in the morning for 8 weeks.

armGroups.label: Arm III
armGroups.description: Patients receive 250 mg armodafinil orally every day in the morning for 8 weeks.
